# GDW Mirror — Full documentation

For complete documentation, see [README.md](README.md) (Spanish) and [README.en.md](README.en.md) (English). The application is one dual-role app for macOS and Windows: either computer can share its screen for the other to view, one direction at a time. It starts from the menu bar/system tray and lets you share the local screen or open the remote viewer.

## Build

Install dependencies with `npm ci`. Run the dual app in development with `npm run dev`. Build macOS ZIP and DMG artifacts with `npm run dist:mac` (add `-- --x64` for Intel). Build the Windows x64 installer and portable executable with `npm run dist:win`. Artifacts are written under `dist/dual/`.

## Packaging and releases

- [builder/dual.yml](builder/dual.yml) is the only packaging configuration for macOS and Windows.
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) builds the dual app for macOS Apple Silicon/Intel and Windows x64, then publishes the artifacts and SHA-256 checksums to GitHub Releases.
- [.github/workflows/build-msix.yml](.github/workflows/build-msix.yml) manually builds the Windows installer and portable version.
- [builder/RELEASE-NOTES.md](builder/RELEASE-NOTES.md) contains release notes in Spanish and English.
